entries.error_behavior: a client that has gone is absent from the next listing rather than reported as an error; a command aimed at one reports CommandFailure
a pane that has gone reports CommandFailure; the call drops remembered history and leaves the visible screen
entering twice is harmless; leaving a pane that is in no mode is refused with tmux's own message rather than reported as success
a pane that has gone reports CommandFailure carrying tmux's message
a window that has gone, or a pane that has, reports CommandFailure; the pane keeps its id across the move
a buffer that has gone, or a pane that has, reports CommandFailure; the text is delivered unexecuted
an empty command is refused before dispatch rather than read as tmux's spelling of stop; a pane that has gone reports CommandFailure
a pane whose process is still running is refused unless replace_running is asked for, which is tmux's own refusal kept rather than smoothed over
a pane that has gone reports CommandFailure; a title beginning with a dash is data, and needs no guard because -T consumes its value
a key name tmux does not know is refused by tmux and reported; a table name containing whitespace, an empty key and an empty command are refused before dispatch
a buffer that has already gone reports CommandFailure rather than succeeding
a message to a server with no client is dispatched and seen by nobody, which tmux reports as success
a server that is already gone reports CommandFailure rather than succeeding silently; the sessions end because the server does
a server that is already gone reports CommandFailure rather than succeeding silently; the sessions end because the server does
a server holding none answers with an empty list, as every listing here does
a server that cannot be reached reports CommandFailure; the listing itself never partially parses, so a row is either a command or the whole call failed
a file the server cannot read reports CommandFailure with tmux's message; an unnamed buffer is refused before dispatch
a name tmux rejects, or a server that cannot be reached, is reported as CommandFailure with tmux's own message; never a partially created session
a command that exits non-zero is a failure carrying its status in exit_code; an empty command is refused before dispatch
a path the server cannot write reports CommandFailure; an unnamed buffer is refused before dispatch
text beginning with a dash is text, not a flag; a server that cannot be reached reports CommandFailure
reading a buffer that has gone is a failure, not empty contents
a file the server cannot read, and a file holding a command tmux does not know, both report CommandFailure carrying tmux's message
unbinding in a table that does not exist reports CommandFailure; unbinding a key that was not bound succeeds
an unnamed channel is refused before dispatch; nobody signalling is a timeout; a server that ends under the waiter is a failure, though tmux itself exits zero
the same call under another name: nothing is dispatched, and the command line is the caller's to exec
nothing is dispatched: the command line is built from the session's own id, and a session that has gone yields a target tmux will refuse when the caller execs it
a session with nobody attached is refused rather than treated as done: tmux answers 'no current client' at a non-zero status, uniformly across the supported range
tmux refuses when there is nowhere to go; reported as FailureKind::refused with tmux's message, never a silent reselect
tmux refuses when there is nowhere to go; reported as FailureKind::refused with tmux's message, never a silent reselect
tmux refuses when there is nowhere to go; reported as FailureKind::refused with tmux's message, never a silent reselect
a window that has gone reports CommandFailure carrying tmux's message
a window holding one pane is refused rather than reselecting it, as tmux does; the previously selected pane is server state a listing does not report
a session that has gone reports CommandFailure; the window is shared, not copied
a window that has gone reports CommandFailure; a window holding one pane succeeds and changes nothing, as tmux does
a window that has gone reports CommandFailure; a window holding one pane succeeds and changes nothing, as tmux does
a window that has gone reports CommandFailure with tmux's message; the selection does not move
a window that has gone reports CommandFailure with tmux's message; the selection does not move
removing the last link is refused rather than leaving a window no session holds; kill is the way to be rid of it
